title: C++ API
description: Header-only C++17 API with RAII semantics. Covers novasvg::Document, novasvg::Element, novasvg::Bitmap, novasvg::Matrix, novasvg::Box and novasvg::Color: loading from files, strings or memory, CSS selector queries, stylesheets, transforms, font management and rasterization to bitmaps or PNG.
